newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice prices seen falling on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice prices seen falling on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to fall next week amid weak demand from abroad, dealers said on Thursday.
"At the moment there is no major buyer in the market," dealer Khalid Ghori of Matco Rice Processing Ltd said.
He said an export deal for 40,000 tonnes of IRRI-6 with the Iraqi government mooted last week had not been finalised, while demand from Dubai and Iran has also ebbed.
In October rice exports fell to 65,964 tonnes worth $22 million, down from 74,589 tonnes worth $25 million in September and 76,099 tonnes worth $28 million in October 1995.
